option_relations.rationale: Frontotemporal Dementia (FTD) is a broader category and does not fully encompass the specific genetic and clinical findings presented in the vignette, which point to a more specific diagnosis.
Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis–Frontotemporal Dementia (ALS-FTD) is a clinical syndrome, but the option does not specify the genetic cause (TBK1-related) which is a key finding in the vignette.

Frontotemporal lobar degeneration–motor neuron disease (FTLD-MND) is a pathological classification and does not fully capture the clinical and genetic specifics of the case, particularly the TBK1 mutation.

The option 'Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis-frontotemporal dementia (ALS-FTD) spectrum disorder (TBK1-related)' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'TBK1-related amyotrophic lateral sclerosis-frontotemporal dementia spectrum disorder'. Both describe the same specific disease entity, incorporating the ALS-FTD spectrum and the causative TBK1 gene mutation.
